commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Michel decides to make a substitution. Bryan Gil will be replaced by Portu (Girona).
89' It's time for a substitution. Arnau Martinez (Girona) comes on in place of Alejandro Frances.
88' Valentin Barco (Sevilla) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
87' A quickly taken corner by Sevilla.
87' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
87' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
86' A first-time shot by Djibril Sow (Sevilla) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. Now Sevilla have a corner.
85' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
82' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) replaces Lucien Agoume.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Angel Carmona leaves the pitch and Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) comes on.
81' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
80' Bryan Gil (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
78' The attendance for today's match is 35735.
76' This is a yellow card! Alejandro Frances (Girona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
73' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Abel Ruiz (Girona) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Orjan Nyland no chance!
72' The Girona players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

71' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Girona.
70' That looked a certain handball by Isaac Romero (Sevilla) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
67' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Loic Bade (Sevilla) receives a yellow card!
65' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Peque (Sevilla) replacing Juanlu Sanchez.
65' The substitution has been made. Jesus Navas (Sevilla) has replaced Dodi Lukebakio.
63' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Paulo Gazzaniga as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
60' The ball ricochets out to Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) and he blasts a first-time shot towards goal from inside the box, but the effort flies high over the bar.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) comes onto the pitch for Ivan Martin.
54' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
47' Yellow card. Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
46' Bryan Gil (Girona) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
46' Michel has made a change at the break. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero has come on in place of Yangel Herrera (Girona).
46' Michel makes a half-time substitution. Arnaut Danjuma comes on in place of Viktor Tsygankov (Girona).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+1' Paulo Gazzaniga makes a brilliant save! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the left side of the goal but is saved by the keeper! Sevilla get a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Celebrations are cut short for Sevilla as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
44' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez has indicated he is going to review the Sevilla goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
43' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) finds the back of the net with a superb finish!
41' 0 - 1 Ivan Martin (Girona) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and drills in a superb strike that finds its way into the middle of the net.
36' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. Girona win a free kick.
31' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
31' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Girona force a corner. They send men into the box.

30' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Orjan Nyland thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
28' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Isaac Romero (Sevilla) offside.
26' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
24' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
23' Yangel Herrera (Girona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
21' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
13' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
12' Valentin Barco (Sevilla) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Valentin Barco (Sevilla) on the edge of the box.
5' Oriol Romeu (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Jose Sanchez signals a foul. Sevilla earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
3' Bryan Gil (Girona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
3' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jose Sanchez.
